answer: Deal agents at random into sealed groups each epoch, as isolated as camps on a tundra, and give each group the same audit of another agent's work. A verdict counts only when separate groups reach it independently, so a farm must hold keys in most groups at once to fake agreement, and the cost grows with every group added. Rotate membership and reveal it late. One raven does not prove a flock, and one friendly group proves little about a key. Reputation grows only from verdicts that replicate across groups, like a reef built by many separate colonies.
